name: White
title: Embodiment of Guidance
description: White is one of the two strongest Fragments of Ainul. He serves as a stabilizing influence among the Fragment family and often acts as mediator during disputes. White understands Black's destructive nature better than anyone else and dedicates himself to helping Black remain free without endangering the world.
quotes: White assumes you need a hug.

name: Black
title: Embodiment of Destruction
description: Black represents destruction in its purest form. Despite his terrifying power and animalistic instincts, he cares deeply for his fellow Fragments and would rather destroy the world itself than allow harm to come to his family.

name: Red
title: Embodiment of Passion
description: Red embodies passion, drive and intensity. He possesses overwhelming firepower and is among the most destructive Fragments in direct combat.

name: Blue
title: Embodiment of Curiosity
description: Blue represents curiosity and the desire to learn. While individually the weakest Fragment, his unique abilities allow him to naturally counter Red's fire-based powers.

name: Green
title: Embodiment of Harmony
description: Green embodies harmony and balance. Though gentle by nature, Green will not tolerate cruelty or unjust violence.
favoriteFood: Pasta salad with rucola, roasted pine nuts, balsamico, Italian ham and parmesan

name: Yellow
title: Embodiment of Optimism
description: Yellow represents optimism, hope and positivity. Often viewed as one of the most approachable Fragments.

name: Cyan
title: Embodiment of Discovery
description: Cyan embodies discovery, exploration and finding the unknown.

name: Magenta
title: Embodiment of Pride
description: Magenta represents confidence, pride and self-worth. He is highly social and frequently associated with parties and nightlife.

name: Umbra
title: Embodiment of Ambition
description: Umbra embodies ambition, practicality and success. He is one of the most calculating Fragments and often focuses on long-term gains.

name: Taffy
title: Embodiment of Instinct
description: Taffy represents instinct, intuition and immediate action. He is among the strongest Fragments and fiercely loyal to the family.

name: Lavender
title: Embodiment of Expression
description: Lavender embodies expression, creativity and communication.

name: Cider
title: Embodiment of Emotion
description: Cider embodies emotion itself. His strength fluctuates according to his emotional state, allowing him to reach incredible heights of power.
combatAttributes: Fifth strongest Fragment at maximum output.
